spanish: Y se fortaleció el corazón de Faraón, y no oyó a ellos, como habló Jehová.
grammarChanges: h02007013007: replaced «como que» with «como» — כַּאֲשֶׁר is preposition + relative (accordance: as / according as); «como que» in current Latin American Spanish reads as semblance ('as if') or justification, which the token does not carry.
